name: The Reeve's Letter
introduction: Odda presses a letter into your hand. 'For the steward at Hollin Keep, about the fen road. He sees petitioners from eight in the morning until eight at night, and not a minute after.'
progress: The steward has the reeve's letter. Odda will want to know.
completion: Odda cuts a new notch in her stick. 'Then the keep knows. Take this; the gatekeepers will let you in after dark.'
